purpose: Runtime compatibility contract that EOReader 7 must satisfy for The Fold before native v7 migration begins.

serve.mjs.role: validates append-only build records against the engine task vocabulary

semanticCapabilities: addressable source material with reopenable evidence ranges
incremental text segmentation derived from form
relation vocabulary discovery and relation extraction
provenanced text priors and locally reproducible prior data
host projections for terrains, kinds, referents, relations and fold extraction
migrationLaw: EOReader 7 must first satisfy this contract without requiring The Fold runtime changes.
Historical module paths may be implemented by a v6 compatibility facade over v7 internals.
Compatibility paths are removable only after The Fold has migrated that dependency to a canonical v7 API and equivalent behavior remains tested.
The contract describes required behavior and callable surfaces, not required v7 internal architecture.
